   223	/** Canonical identity excludes the atom's truth value but includes its full typed subject. */
   224	export function scenarioFactKey(atom: ScenarioFactAtom): string {
   225	  switch (atom.kind) {
   226	    case 'life_state_is': return `life:${selectorKey(atom.subject)}`;
   227	    case 'hp_percent': return `hp:${selectorKey(atom.subject)}:${String(atom.threshold)}`;
   228	    case 'adjacency_is': return `adjacency:${selectorKey(atom.left)}:${selectorKey(atom.right)}`;
   229	    case 'within_action_reach_is': return `reach:${selectorKey(atom.actor)}:${atom.actionId}:${selectorKey(atom.target)}`;
   230	    case 'visibility_is': return `visibility:${selectorKey(atom.observer)}:${selectorKey(atom.subject)}`;
   231	    case 'zone_occupancy_is': return `zone:${selectorKey(atom.subject)}:${atom.zoneId}`;
   232	    case 'condition_is': return `condition:${selectorKey(atom.subject)}:${canonicalJson(atom.condition)}`;
   233	    case 'resource_available_is': return `resource:${selectorKey(atom.subject)}:${canonicalJson(atom.resource)}`;
   234	    case 'concentration_is': return `concentration:${selectorKey(atom.subject)}`;
   235	  }
   236	}

   238	export function complementScenarioFact(
   239	  atom: ScenarioFactAtom,
   240	  lifeStateFlip?: LifeState,
   241	): ScenarioFactAtom {
   242	  switch (atom.kind) {
   243	    case 'life_state_is': {
   244	      if (lifeStateFlip === undefined || lifeStateFlip === atom.value) {
   245	        throw new RangeError('A life-state complement requires one distinct host-proven reachable state.');
   246	      }
   247	      return { ...atom, value: lifeStateFlip };
   248	    }
   249	    case 'hp_percent': return { ...atom, comparison: atom.comparison === 'at_most' ? 'above' : 'at_most' };
   250	    case 'adjacency_is': return { ...atom, value: !atom.value };
   251	    case 'within_action_reach_is': return { ...atom, value: !atom.value };
   252	    case 'visibility_is': return { ...atom, value: !atom.value };
   253	    case 'zone_occupancy_is': return { ...atom, value: atom.value === 'inside' ? 'outside' : 'inside' };
   254	    case 'condition_is': return { ...atom, present: !atom.present };
   255	    case 'resource_available_is': return { ...atom, available: !atom.available };
   256	    case 'concentration_is': return { ...atom, active: !atom.active };
   257	  }
   258	}
   259	
   260	export function scenarioFactsAreComplements(
   261	  left: ScenarioFactAtom,
   262	  right: ScenarioFactAtom,
   263	): boolean {
   264	  if (scenarioFactKey(left) !== scenarioFactKey(right) || left.kind !== right.kind) return false;
   265	  if (left.kind === 'life_state_is' && right.kind === 'life_state_is') return left.value !== right.value;
   266	  try {
   267	    return canonicalJson(complementScenarioFact(left)) === canonicalJson(right);
   268	  } catch {
   269	    return false;
   270	  }
   271	}

   285	function optionIsOffensive(option: EngineOfferableOption): boolean {
   286	  return option.actionSlots.some((slot) => slot.slot === 'main' &&
   287	    (slot.use.kind === 'attack' || slot.use.kind === 'multiattack' || slot.use.kind === 'saving_throw'));

   290	export const hostBaselineProposalPlanner: HostBaselineProposalPlanner = Object.freeze({
   291	  plan(
   292	    state: EncounterState,
   293	    actors: readonly CombatantId[],
   294	    environment: EngineOptionEnvironment,
   295	  ): readonly EngineTurnProposal[] {
   296	    const planningState = projectFutureMonsterTurns(state, actors);
   297	    return actors.flatMap((actorId) => {
   298	      const options = availableEngineActorOptions(planningState, actorId, environment);
   299	      const primary = options.find(optionIsOffensive) ?? options[0];
   300	      if (primary === undefined) return [];
   301	      const fallback = options.find((option) => option.actionSlots.some((slot) =>
   302	        slot.slot === 'main' && slot.use.kind === 'dodge')) ?? null;
   303	      return [{ actorId, expectedRevision: state.revision, primaryOptionId: primary.optionId,
   304	        fallbackOptionId: fallback?.optionId ?? null,
   305	        reason: 'Use the strongest currently available offensive option.',
   306	        overrideJustification: null }];
   307	    });
   308	  },
   309	});

   317	function hpThreshold(current: number, maximum: number): HpThresholdPercent {
   318	  if (current * 100 <= maximum * 25) return 25;
   319	  if (current * 100 <= maximum * 50) return 50;
   320	  if (current * 100 <= maximum * 75) return 75;
   321	  return 75;
   322	}

   326	  proposalActorId: CombatantId,

   329	): void {
   330	  entries.push({
   331	    proposalActorId,
   332	    baseline,
   333	    flipped: complementScenarioFact(baseline, lifeFlip),
   334	  });
   335	}

   337	function optionSelectors(option: EngineOfferableOption): readonly EngineSelectorRef[] {
   338	  return option.actionSlots.flatMap((slot) => {
   339	    const use = slot.use;
   340	    const selectors = use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw' ? [use.target]
   341	      : use.kind === 'multiattack' ? use.components.map((component) => component.target)
   342	        : use.kind === 'cast_spell' ? use.targets : [];
   343	    return selectors.map((selector) => ({ actorId: option.actorId, selector }));
   344	  });
   345	}

   347	export function extractProposalFactDependencies(
   348	  state: EncounterState,
   349	  options: readonly EngineOfferableOption[],
   350	  queries: EngineQueryPort,
   351	): readonly ProposalFactDependency[] {

   354	    const actorRef = directRef(option.actorId, option.actorId);
   355	    const actor = queries.combatant(state, option.actorId);
   356	    if (actor === null) continue;
   357	    addDependency(entries, option.actorId, {
   358	      kind: 'life_state_is', subject: actorRef, value: actor.life,
   359	    }, actor.life === 'living' ? 'dead' : 'living');
   360	    addDependency(entries, option.actorId, {
   361	      kind: 'resource_available_is', subject: actorRef,
   362	      resource: { kind: 'reaction' }, available: actor.turn.reactionAvailable,
   363	    });
   364	    addDependency(entries, option.actorId, {
   365	      kind: 'concentration_is', subject: actorRef,
   366	      active: engineConcentrationActive(state, option.actorId),
   367	    });
   368	    if (actor.legendary !== undefined) {
   369	      for (const resource of [{ kind: 'legendary_action' }, { kind: 'legendary_resistance' }] as const) {
   370	        const available = resource.kind === 'legendary_action'
   371	          ? actor.legendary.actionUsesRemaining > 0
   372	          : actor.legendary.resistanceUsesRemaining > 0;
   373	        addDependency(entries, option.actorId, {
   374	          kind: 'resource_available_is', subject: actorRef, resource, available,
   375	        });
   376	      }
   377	    }
   378	    for (const targetRef of optionSelectors(option)) {
   379	    const targetId = resolveSelector(state, targetRef, queries);
   380	    if (targetId === null) continue;
   381	    const target = queries.combatant(state, targetId);
   382	    if (target === null) continue;
   383	    addDependency(entries, option.actorId, {
   384	      kind: 'life_state_is', subject: targetRef, value: target.life,
   385	    }, target.life === 'living' ? 'dead' : 'living');

   444	  switch (atom.kind) {

   446	    case 'hp_percent':
   447	    case 'zone_occupancy_is':
   448	    case 'condition_is':
   449	    case 'resource_available_is':
   450	    case 'concentration_is': return [atom.subject];
   451	    case 'adjacency_is': return [atom.left, atom.right];

   457	function candidateAdvertised(
   458	  state: EncounterState,
   459	  baseline: ScenarioFactAtom,
   460	  queries: EngineQueryPort,
   461	): boolean {
   462	  const resolved = selectorRefs(baseline).map((reference) => resolveSelector(state, reference, queries));
   463	  if (resolved.some((id) => id === null)) return false;

+## Outcome and non-negotiable gates

+COHORT-01 preserves historical D569 inputs, creates three solid-wall brutal
+cohorts, activates v6/v2, adds versioned routes, reconciles three behavior

+3. Never rewrite a historical fixture/manifest, add a D466 override, use
+   `--terrain-profile`, hand-edit generated JSON, or relax membership. If one
